title: Forensic Image Capture — MBW-HMI-02

lines.msg: Forensic image of MBW-HMI-02 (10.72.10.22) completed via Kessler Controls remote session.
Source: DosaTech ScreenBridge session (10.200.144.122) — 08:00:14 to 09:12:26
Image hash (SHA-256): f8b3c9d1e4a7f2c1b6e8d5a9c3b2f1e7d6c4a8b5e2f3d1c7a9b6e4f2a1c3d5b8
Chain of custody: SEC-4-2026-1022-121803 signed by Luis Ferreira (SEC) and Priya Nandakumar (TL)
MBW-HMI-02 is not powered down. The DosaTech ScreenBridge agent remains active. No reboot or reset has occurred.
FBI/CISA liaison (WaterISAC Case #WIS-2026-041122) has been notified. Evidence review pending.
Session log from DosaTech ScreenBridge preserved: /forensics/mbw-hmi-02/082212_session.log
MBW-NVR-01 footage (09:58:33) and PACS logs (09:58:30–09:58:35) sealed in evidence package (SEC-4-2026-1022-121803)
Attempt to access MBW-HMI-02 via local console failed: no valid MFA token detected. System remains locked.
No changes to HMI state since 09:58:33. No manual intervention detected.
Image verified: 100% match to original HMI state at 09:58:33 (prior to attacker session).
Forensic image stored on MBW-JUMP-01 (10.72.10.100) and copied to CISA secure vault (WIS-2026-041122).

instructorNote: This inject confirms that the forensic chain of custody is complete and that the FBI/CISA liaison has been engaged. The team must not attempt to reboot, reimage, or access the HMI until the forensic review is complete.
